summary: Hyperion Defi, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a firm-commitment underwritten public offering of 2,777,778 shares of common stock at $3.60 per share, for total proceeds of ~$9.4 million to the company. The underwriter, Chardan, has a 30-day option for an additional 416,666 shares. The offering is a routine shelf takedown under Rule 424(b)(5), not a special situation; it is a standard equity capital raise with no transformative or structural event. The stock trades on Nasdaq under HYPD. No special-situation category applies.
